ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Curl Change User Agents - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious curl process start on linux with set useragent options

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/curl$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-A\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-user\\-agent\\ .*")))
